spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The aarakocra is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). The aarakocra has the following wizard spells prepared:

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

variant.name: Familiars
entries: Any spellcaster that can cast the {@spell find familiar} spell (such as an archmage or aarakocra) is likely to have a familiar. The familiar can be one of the creatures described in the spell (see the Player's Handbook) or some other Tiny monster, such as a {@creature crawling claw}, {@creature imp}, {@creature pseudodragon}, or {@creature quasit}.

name: Agony
languages: any languages it knew in life

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: Agony can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: Agony can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: Agony enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of Agony that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages {@dice 1d4 × 10} years. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a  {@spell greater restoration} spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

action.name: Possession {@recharge}
entries: One humanoid that Agony can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Agony; Agony then disappears, and the target is {@condition incapacitated} and loses control of its body. Agony now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Agony can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened}. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Agony ends it as a bonus action, or Agony is turned or forced out by an effect like the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. When the possession ends, Agony reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: While it has at least 1 hit point, the astral blight sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: The blight doesn't require air or sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The blight makes two Heat-Draining Vine attacks.

action.name: Heat-Draining Vine
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) radiant damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this grapple ends, the target takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) cold damage at the start of each of its turns. The blight has two vines, each of which can grapple one creature.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: Big Momma doesn't require air.

action.name: Swallowing Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}45 ({@damage 6d12 + 6}) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or be swallowed by Big Momma. Big Momma can have one creature swallowed at a time.

A swallowed creature is {@condition blinded} and {@condition restrained}, has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} against attacks and other effects outside Big Momma, and takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage at the start of each of Big Momma's turns from the digestive juices in Big Momma's gullet.

If Big Momma takes 25 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Big Momma must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls {@condition prone} in a space within 10 feet of Big Momma. If Big Momma dies, a swallowed creature is no longer {@condition restrained} by it and can escape from the corpse by using 10 feet of movement, exiting {@condition prone}.

bonus.name: Ray of Fear {@recharge 4}
entries: Big Momma's eye emits an {@condition invisible}, magical ray that targets one creature Big Momma can see within 60 feet of itself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Big Momma until the start of Big Momma's next turn.

trait.name: Firearms Knowledge
entries: Krux's mastery of its weapons enables it to ignore the loading property of any firearm.

trait.name: Steady as She Goes
entries: On the deck of a ship, Krux has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made against effects that would knock it {@condition prone} or shove it overboard.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Krux makes two Longsword or Musket attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Musket
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Force Grenade
entries: Krux throws a grenade up to 60 feet, and the grenade explodes in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 ({@damage 5d6}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After Krux throws the grenade, roll a {@dice d6}; on a roll of 4 or lower, Krux has no more grenades to throw.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Elaina makes three melee attacks: two with its scimitar and one with its dagger. Or Elaina makes two ranged attacks with its daggers.

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) slashing damage.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: Elaina adds 2 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Elaina must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Fel is a 4th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 11}, {@hit 3} to hit with spell attacks). Fel has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Dark Devotion
entries: Fel has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Fel makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Dagger
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Advanced Telepathy
entries: Flapjack can perceive the content of any telepathic communication used within 60 feet of it, and it can't be {@status surprised} by creatures with any form of telepathy.

trait.name: Prone Deficiency
entries: If Flapjack is knocked {@condition prone}, roll a die. On an odd result, Flapjack lands upside-down and is {@condition incapacitated}. At the end of each of its turns, Flapjack can make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, righting itself and ending the {@condition incapacitated} condition if it succeeds.

trait.name: Telepathic Shroud
entries: Flapjack is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as all divination spells.

action.name: Tendrils
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw, taking 2 ({@damage 1d4}) acid damage on a failure or ending the recurring acid damage on a success. A {@spell lesser restoration} spell cast on the target also ends the recurring acid damage.

action.name: Stench Spray (1/Day)
entries: Each creature in a 15-foot cone originating from Flapjack must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be coated in a foul-smelling liquid. A coated creature exudes a horrible stench for {@dice 1d4} hours. The coated creature is {@condition poisoned} as long as the stench lasts, and other creatures are {@condition poisoned} while with in 5 feet of the coated creature. A creature can remove the stench on itself by using a short rest to bathe in water, alcohol, or vinegar.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Flapjack casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

name: Grimzod Gargenhale
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Explode
entries: When Grimzod is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a cloud of ash. Any creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 3d10}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Grimzod can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: Grimzod doesn't require air or drink.

action.name: Energy Drain
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) necrotic damage. A Humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this attack dies and instantly transforms into a free-willed shadow or vampirate (captain's choice) under the DM's control.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d10 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Ship Invisibility (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: A ship upon which Grimzod stands, along with all creatures and objects aboard it, becomes {@condition invisible} to creatures not aboard the ship. Grimzod must concentrate on this magical effect to maintain it (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell), and it lasts for up to 1 hour. The effect ends if Grimzod leaves the ship.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: Grimzod halves the damage that it takes from an attack that hits it. Grimzod must be able to see the attacker.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: Hastain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Glory
entries: Hastain's Armor Class includes its Charisma modifier.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Hastain can hold its breath for 1 hour.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Hastain wears a {@item talarith|BAM}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hastain makes two Trident attacks.

action.name: Trident
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) force damage if Hastain is wearing its talarith.

action.name: Chromatic Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 10} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 5d8}) damage of a type chosen by Hastain from the following list: cold, fire, lightning, or radiant.

action.name: Summon Duplicate (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Using its talarith, Hastain summons a duplicate of itself. The duplicate obeys Hastain's commands and uses Hastain's statistics, except it is an unaligned Construct that doesn't have a talarith of its own. The duplicate takes its turn immediately after Hastain. It vanishes after 1 hour or when it is reduced to 0 hit points.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Xeleth casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

trait.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: Xeleth has advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on itself, and magic can't put it to sleep.

trait.name: Special Equipment
entries: Xeleth wears a suit of {@item elven chain}.

trait.name: Unusual Nature
entries: Xeleth doesn't require sleep.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Xeleth makes two Scimitar attacks and uses Radiant Beam (if available).

action.name: Scimitar
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) radiant damage.

action.name: Radiant Beam (3/Day)
entries: A magical beam of radiance flashes out from Xeleth's hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

bonus.name: Starlight Step (3/Day)
entries: Xeleth magically teleports up to 30 feet, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space it can see.

bonus.name: Summon Solar Dragon (1/Day)
entries: Xeleth has a 50 percent chance of magically summoning a {@creature young solar dragon|BAM}. A summoned dragon appears in an unoccupied space that the summoner can see, acts on its own initiative count, and is an ally of its summoner. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

headerEntries: Vocath casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

trait.name: Mercane Telepathy
entries: Vocath can communicate telepathically with any other mercane it knows, regardless of the distance between them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Vocath makes three Psi-Imbued Blade attacks.

action.name: Psi-Imbued Blade
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) slashing damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of Vocath until the end of the target's next turn.
